name: meta:question-quality
description: The question meta-type asked of Jev itself: is a proposed question literal, single, answerable from one record, and decisive? Run it over atomsAsItems(context) to vet a new context's questions before spending calls on them. The deterministic lint (meta-type.ts) runs first; this catches what a word list cannot.

modules.name: answerability
modules.purpose: One record of the stated artifact type can answer the question, literally.

needsOtherRecords.instructions: To answer this question, would someone need to look at records other than the single artifact it is asked about?

criteria.true: It needs other records, history, a baseline or a population.
criteria.false: The single artifact contains everything needed.

asksForJudgementOfDegree.instructions: Does the question ask how much of a vague quality something has, without saying what each answer would look like?

criteria.true: A matter of degree with undefined ends, e.g. how good or how substantive.
criteria.false: The answers are defined by observable features.

twoQuestionsInOne.instructions: Does the question combine two separate conditions, so that one could be true while the other is false?

criteria.true: Two conditions joined, e.g. by and or or.

compose.positive: the question is well-formed for Jev

notForJev.judgement: Does the question become decisive on real data?
notForJev.instead: Measure it: kit/run.ts label-free quality mode on a sample (atEnds, spread); promote only questions measured JEV-SAFE.
